Q1: Where should `/reclarify` at the start of a later line count? First-line commands remain unchanged.
Choices:
A. Only on issues waiting for a human answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B. On every open issue with a trusted, marker-free comment.
Q2: Is the 15-minute answered-but-unrouted detector in scope for this issue?
Choices:
A. Yes, as requested in the issue description. (RECOMMENDED)
B. No, defer it to the separate plan named in the progress comment.
